coferment.quote: Project Ultraviolet  (Our Co-ferment Blend) - 6.0 Roast Date 10/6

An innovative blend built from co-fermented red fruits, watermelon co-ferm, Honduran pink bourbon, Colombian Chiroso and a splash of natural Yirgacheffe — designed for clarity, balance, and real drinkability.
By combining select co-fermented coffees, we’ve created something beyond intensity — a cup that is expressive, structured, and remarkably easy to drink.
Where co-ferments can overwhelm on their own, Ultraviolet brings them into balance.
Built with Co-Ferments — Designed to Be Drinkable
Co-fermented coffees are known for their intensity and experimental character.

processing.process: Freshly harvested cherries are hand-picked at peak ripeness, depulped the same day, and fermented in concrete tanks for 10–12 hours. After washing, the parchment is spread in thin layers across raised drying beds, where it is turned every 30–40 minutes throughout the day to promote slow, even drying.

processing.process: The family has standardized their processing through years of trial and error. First, they pick cherries at optimal ripeness, and then float them to remove under-ripe cherries. From there, cherries are moved to large plastic tanks equipped with a receptacle to collect the mucilage (or mosto) where an oxidative fermentation begins in the open air environment—this oxidation enhances fruit and chocol
